title: Commercial Property Paralegal
description:
Commercial Property Paralegal
- Location: Central Edinburgh
- Job Type: Full-time, Office-based

Our client, a specialist legal firm known for its collaborative and social work environment, is seeking a Commercial Property Paralegal. This role is perfect for individuals with established experience in handling small business sales and purchases within the commercial property sector. Situated in a central location in Edinburgh, the position offers substantial senior support and a vibrant office culture amidst the heart of the city.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Assist in the management of small business sales and purchases within the commercial property sector.
- Prepare legal documents, contracts, and other paperwork related to commercial property transactions.
- Conduct legal research and provide support on property law matters.
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, and other parties to ensure smooth transaction processes.
- Manage and maintain files and records with accuracy and confidentiality.
- Participate in team meetings and collaborate closely with senior staff to discuss case details and strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a paralegal, specifically in commercial property and small business transactions.
- Strong understanding of property law and the legal aspects of property sales and purchases.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively in a collaborative team environment.
- Proficiency in legal research tools and software.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- High level of senior support and professional development opportunities.
- Vibrant, social office culture with regular team events.
- Central office location in Edinburgh.

To apply for this opportunity, please submit your CV or reach out to Kate Irvine at Reed for more information.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal

Location: Edinburgh
Salary: Competitive + Benefits
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

Reed are currently recruiting for an experienced Conveyancing Paralegal to join a well-established and growing firm in Edinburgh. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional to take ownership of a varied residential conveyancing caseload while working alongside experienced solicitors in a supportive and collaborative environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing conveyancing transactions from instruction through to completion, ensuring clients receive a professional and efficient service throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a caseload of residential conveyancing transactions, including sales, purchases, transfers of title and remortgages.
- Draft and review legal documentation and correspondence.
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, lenders, estate agents and other third parties.
- Conduct property searches and review title deeds and reports.
- Prepare settlement statements and completion documentation.
- Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, regulatory requirements and internal procedures.
- Provide exceptional client service and maintain accurate case records.

About You
- Previous experience working as a Conveyancing Paralegal within a Scottish legal practice.
- Strong understanding of the residential conveyancing process in Scotland.
- Ability to manage a busy caseload with minimal supervision.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and client relationship management skills.
- Proficiency in case management systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- Paralegal Accreditation qualification would be desirable but not essential.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid working opportunities.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Career development and progression opportunities.
- Exposure to a diverse range of residential property transactions.

How to Apply

If this is of interest, please apply with an up to date copy of your CV or contact Zoe King at Reed for more information.

title: Employment Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary - Employment

Edinburgh Full-time Hybrid Working

Are you an experienced Legal Secretary looking for your next opportunity in Edinburgh? A highly regarded international law firm is seeking a proactive and organised Legal Secretary to join its established Employment team.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading legal practice, providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to Partners, solicitors and trainees within a busy and collaborative environment.

You will play an important role in the smooth running of the team, managing a varied workload and ensuring an efficient, professional service to both internal and external clients.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing, amending and formatting legal correspondence, agreements, court documents and Employment Tribunal bundles
- Managing diaries, emails, meetings, calls and travel arrangements for Partners and fee-earners
- Liaising with clients, courts and other third parties
- Opening new matters, preparing retainer letters and monitoring key dates and deadlines
- Assisting with billing processes, preparing finance reports and coordinating client billing approvals
- Preparing and formatting presentations, pitch documents and other business development materials
- Managing electronic document platforms and coordinating the signing of settlement agreements
- Working with internal support teams to ensure documents and requests are completed accurately and within agreed timescales
- Providing wider administrative support across the firm when required

About You

You will ideally have previous experience as a Legal Secretary or Legal PA within a law firm, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver a consistently high standard of support.

You will also demonstrate:
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Strong attention to detail and written communication skills
- Good IT skills, including experience with Microsoft Office and PowerPoint
- A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and use your own initiative
- Professionalism and a commitment to delivering excellent client service
- The ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues at all levels

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, reviewed annually
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements
- Generous bonus scheme
- Up to 25 days' annual leave, increasing to 28 days with service
- Holiday exchange scheme
- Private medical insurance
- Enhanced parental leave
- A supportive working environment within a respected international law firm

Interested?

This is an excellent opportunity for a Legal Secretary seeking a new challenge within an established Employment team in Edinburgh, offering varied responsibilities, flexible working and an attractive benefits package.

For a confidential discussion and further information, please get in touch with Melissa Tang at G2 Legal, or apply with an up-to-date CV.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
Legal Administrator - Land and Rural

Location: Edinburgh
Job Type: Permanent, Full-Time

The Opportunity

An established professional services organisation is seeking a highly organised and proactive Legal Administrator to join its specialist property and rural affairs team based in Edinburgh.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to become part of a busy and supportive legal environment, providing comprehensive administrative support across a varied caseload involving property transactions, estate matters, leasing arrangements, renewable energy projects, and other land-related work.

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Compliance
- Support the onboarding of new clients and matters.
- Prepare engagement documentation and client care correspondence.
- Assist with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Client (KYC) requirements.
- Maintain accurate client records and compliance documentation.

Matter Administration
- Open and maintain client files using the firm's case management systems.
- Prepare reports and update matter information as required.
- Ensure all documentation is recorded and managed accurately.
- Maintain electronic and manual filing systems.

Transactional & Property Support
- Request and prepare property searches and related documentation.
- Assist with registration documentation and submissions.
- Prepare Land and Buildings Transaction Tax (LBTT) returns and associated paperwork.
- Provide administrative support throughout property and land transactions.

Document Production
- Produce professional correspondence, reports, forms and legal documents.
- Format, proofread and edit documentation to a high standard.
- Undertake audio typing and dictation where required.
- Prepare presentations, meeting materials and supporting documentation.

Team Support
- Coordinate diary management and scheduling of appointments.
- Arrange travel and accommodation where required.
- Liaise professionally with clients, external contacts and internal stakeholders.
- Assist with the review and continuous improvement of departmental processes and procedures.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider team.

Person Specification

Essential Experience & Skills
- Previous experience in an administrative role within a legal, professional services or corporate environment.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Experience producing and editing professional documents.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Professional and client-focused approach.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience within a legal administration or legal secretary role.
- Experience supporting property, conveyancing or rural business matters.
- Familiarity with case management systems.
- Understanding of AML and client onboarding processes.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Opportunity to work within a well-established and respected professional services environment.
- Structured training and development opportunities.
- Supportive team culture.
- Long-term career progression prospects.

title: Legal PA - Corporate and Employment
description:
Legal PA Corporate & Employment
Edinburgh Hybrid Working Full Time

Are you an experienced Legal PA looking for a role where you can become a genuinely valued part of the team you support?

I'm working with a highly regarded Scottish law firm looking to appoint an experienced Legal PA to join their Edinburgh office, supporting three Partners across Corporate and Employment Law.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, responsibility and working closely with senior fee earners. You'll be right at the heart of two busy practice areas, helping Partners stay organised, keeping matters moving and delivering an excellent service to clients.

Why consider this opportunity? The variety of the role really stands out.

You'll gain exposure across both Corporate and Employment work, with responsibilities ranging from corporate documentation and Companies House forms through to preparing Employment Tribunal bundles.

Alongside the legal work, you'll have ownership across diary management, client onboarding, billing, WIP, aged debt and the day-to-day organisation of your Partners.

The firm offers a supportive and collaborative culture, hybrid working, ongoing development and mentoring, progression opportunities and a competitive benefits package.

Your role will include:
- Providing dedicated PA support to three Partners across Corporate and Employment
- Managing busy diaries, appointments, meetings and email correspondence
- Preparing and amending corporate documentation
- Drafting Companies House forms
- Collating and preparing Employment Tribunal bundles
- Managing client onboarding, conflict checks and compliance requirements
- Supporting monthly billing, WIP and aged debt management
- Producing documents and maintaining accurate files
- Handling calls from existing and prospective clients
- Providing digital dictation support
- Proactively supporting fee earners to improve workflow and efficiency

What are they looking for? Ideally, you'll already have experience as a Legal PA, PA, Legal Executive or in a similar professional support position.

You'll be organised, confident managing competing priorities and comfortable working closely with senior fee earners. Strong client-care skills and excellent attention to detail are essential, alongside confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and Adobe.

Most importantly, they're looking for someone proactive, adaptable and switched-on, who wants to become a trusted part of the team rather than simply wait for tasks to land on their desk.

Interested? If you're an experienced Legal PA in Edinburgh and would like a role offering Partner-level exposure, varied Corporate and Employment work, hybrid working and genuine scope to develop, I'd be keen to speak with you for a confidential conversation.

Rob Wallis
Creideas Recruitment

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Secretary - Residential Conveyancing

Location: Edinburgh
Department: Residential Conveyancing
Hours: 35 hours per week, Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm
Contract Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Secretary to join a busy Residential Conveyancing team in Edinburgh.

This role will suit an organised and proactive individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced legal environment and providing high-quality support to fee earners. The successful candidate will be responsible for a broad range of secretarial and administrative duties, helping to ensure the efficient operation of the department while delivering exceptional service to clients and colleagues alike.

Key Responsibilities

Secretarial Support
- Provide comprehensive secretarial support to Partners and Fee Earners.
- Prepare, amend and format legal correspondence and documentation.
- Undertake digital dictation and audio typing to a high standard.
- Complete legal forms and other documentation as requested.
- Ensure all work is completed accurately and within required timescales.
- Assist with general administrative tasks to support the wider team.

Client Communication
- Handle incoming telephone calls professionally and efficiently.
- Respond to client and third-party enquiries via telephone and email.
- Deliver a consistently high standard of client care.
- Identify potential client care issues and assist in resolving them where appropriate.

Team Support
- Work closely with colleagues and support staff to manage workloads effectively.
- Assist Fee Earners in maximising their time on fee-earning activities.
- Support the smooth running of the Residential Conveyancing department.
- Contribute positively to team objectives and departmental performance.

Systems & Compliance
- Utilise case management and document management systems effectively.
- Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant procedures, processes and regulatory requirements.
- Adhere to health and safety and risk management procedures.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Previous experience within a Residential Conveyancing Secretary position.
- Fast and accurate typing and keyboard skills.
- Experience of digital dictation and audio typing.
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong interpersonal skills and professional telephone manner.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Desirable
- Experience supporting multiple Fee Earners.
- Familiarity with legal case management systems.
- Knowledge of Scottish residential conveyancing procedures and documentation.

Personal Attributes
- Professional and client-focused.
- Proactive and positive approach to work.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Reliable and dependable.
- Team-oriented with excellent communication skills.
- Able to remain calm and organised in a busy environment.
- Committed to delivering excellent client service.

What's on Offer
- Opportunity to join a well-established Residential Conveyancing team.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Ongoing training and professional development.
- Long-term career prospects within a growing legal practice.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
